text.short: Another troubling report arrives from the road.
text.summary: Once local insight has been gathered, a time beat can turn unease into explicit urgency.
text.full: The Grey Road does not wait for perfect certainty. Another troubling report arrives while clues are still being sorted, turning hesitation itself into part of the pressure.

text.recap: A time beat increased the pressure around the investigation.
